description: This file defines a Java interface for MerchantConfiguration data access object (DAO), specifying methods for retrieving merchant configuration data from the database.

classes.name: MerchantConfigurationDao
classes.description: A DAO interface for accessing merchant configuration data, extending generic DAO functionality.

methods.name: getMerchantConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves a specific merchant configuration based on a key and merchant store.

methods.name: getMerchantConfigurations
methods.description: Provides a list of all merchant configurations for a given store.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists merchant configurations filtered by type and store.
